about.bio: I'm a passionate developer and AI enthusiast with a deep love for computer science. My journey began with a curiosity for how things work, which led me to explore the world of ethical hacking and software development. I specialize in building robust web applications and exploring the potential of artificial intelligence to solve real-world problems.
